'''Grayson Graves''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 I-10 Cup (August)]] on 18 August 2001 with [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|WYS w/ spies (rated 1433)]], according to Steve Marshall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2902">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-27-viper-tells-all-phoenix-az-8-19-01d2902/ viper-tells-all-phoenix-az-8-19-01], DeckTech (Steve "BlackViper" Marshall, 27 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-27-viper-tells-all-phoenix-az-8-19-01d2902/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
